Selected work, 2026

2026 · Team project · SolidWorks · 3D printing

Scotch Yoke Mechanism

Reverse-engineered a Scotch Yoke from 2D measurements and reference imagery, rebuilt it as a parametric 3D model, then went beyond replication: a custom vertical drive train with specially designed bevel gears to run it from a salvaged AC fan motor.

  • Converts rotary crank motion into pure sinusoidal linear motion: smoother acceleration and lower jerk than a slider-crank
  • Designed and measured (vernier caliper) bevel gears to fit the motor shaft
  • Torque analysis for motor selection; Finite Element Analysis on parts
  • Full assembly with mates, then printed in PLA to verify form and function
